serialization.executionArtifactCanonicalization: object keys in Unicode code-point ascending order; compact comma/colon separators; arrays preserve declared order

inodeContinuityProcedure: open or create the canonical lock path once and retain that file descriptor
acquire nonblocking exclusive flock on that exact descriptor
write owner metadata only by ftruncate, write and fsync on the same locked descriptor
never rename, unlink, replace or reopen the lock path while ownership is held
before build and immediately before release require fstat(lockedFd) device and inode to equal lstat(lockPath) device and inode
any mismatch is HOLD_INVALID_CHARACTERIZATION and no further build or Player launch is allowed
finalDurabilityProcedure: open same-directory temporary file with exclusive create and no-follow semantics
flush file content and metadata to stable storage
atomically replace result.candidate.json within the same directory
reopen with no-follow semantics and strict-parse exact bytes
rehash and compare the candidate result readback bytes
before lock release reopen every artifactInventory path with no-follow semantics and verify canonical descendant, device/inode stability, size and SHA-256 against FINAL inventory
compute inventoryRootSha256 from verified inventory records
atomically promote the byte-identical candidate to result.json
write the VALID receipt to a same-directory exclusive no-follow temporary file, strict-read and hash-check that temporary file, then fsync it
atomically rename the already-verified receipt temporary file to readback-receipt.json and fsync the directory as the final transport-admission step
lockPolicy.readbackFailureRule: preserve candidate/result bytes only as inadmissible audit material, atomically emit a FAILED readback receipt when possible, never emit a VALID receipt, release lock after cleanup, print the exact transport-failure line, and exit 2
lockPolicy.resultAdmissibilityRule: result.json is admissible only as an exact pair with readback-receipt.json whose readbackStatus is VALID and whose protocolSha256, attemptUuid, resultSha256 and inventoryRootSha256 match current bytes; result-only consumers and FAILED/missing/mismatched receipt pairs MUST return HOLD_INVALID_CHARACTERIZATION

provenanceRequirements.crossAttestationRule: every raw envelope header exactly joins one process record and one build cohort by protocolSha256, attemptUuid, playerRunId, processId and buildId; controlId is non-null only for allocation and experimentId is non-null only for timing

rawDerivedInvariants: signedDeltaBytes equals counterAfterBytes minus counterBeforeBytes without clamp
monotonicAfterTicks is greater than or equal to monotonicBeforeTicks
counterAfterBytes is greater than or equal to counterBeforeBytes
managedThreadIdBefore equals managedThreadIdAfter and equals every record thread id in the envelope
requestedBytes 0 implies retainedSinkIndex null and no allocation or write
requestedBytes 4096 or 8192 implies a unique-within-samplePhase preassigned non-null retainedSinkIndex, exact requested array length, first and last byte written, and retainedThroughAfterRead true
WARMUP positive records use retainedSinkIndex 0..59, then the sink is cleared and reset before MEASURED; MEASURED positive records use retainedSinkIndex 0..199
sampleOrdinal equals ((tripletOrdinal - 1) * 3) + controlOrdinal within its samplePhase
GC collection counters are nondecreasing within each record

acceptanceAllOf.medianArithmetic: exact rational arithmetic; compare the unrounded median difference to 4096

timingProtocol.duplicateDefinition: two records with the same tupleIdentityKey are duplicates regardless of timestamps or metric values
timingProtocol.expectedCoordinateDomain: for each experiment process, take both orderedWorkloadIds, that process's declared logical repetition domain, both orderedPhases and tickOrdinal 1..200; the Cartesian product must occur exactly once
timingProtocol.coordinateDerivedFields: executionSlot is the 1-based position of logicalRepetition in that process declared order; workloadInstanceOrdinal is 1-based within the declared workload and repetition construction order

phaseConditionalTypes.TIMING_CAPTURE_ON: cleanupProcessorTicks, runCleanupPhaseTicks and wholeTickTicks are nonnegative integers with cleanupProcessorTicks <= runCleanupPhaseTicks <= wholeTickTicks
phaseConditionalTypes.CAPTURE_OFF: cleanupProcessorTicks and runCleanupPhaseTicks are exactly null; wholeTickTicks is a nonnegative integer

noise.repetitionP95Rule: for each sampleSetKey, compute Type-7 q=0.95 over exactly 200 raw integer tick values; null is permitted only for phase-metric pairs absent from phaseMetricMatrix and is never coerced to zero
noise.zeroDenominatorRule: if median is zero and all three values are zero, noise is 0.000000; otherwise the experiment is INVALID
noise.phaseLocalWithinProcessRule: for each PHASE_LOCAL playerRunId and each allowed candidate-workload phase-metric pair, compute noise across logical repetitions 1,2,3
noise.phaseLocalCrossProcessRule: for each logical repetition and each allowed candidate-workload phase-metric pair, compute noise across the three PHASE_LOCAL playerRunId repetitionP95 values
noise.freshRepetitionWithinProcessRule: NOT_APPLICABLE because each FRESH_REPETITION process owns exactly one logical repetition
noise.freshRepetitionCrossProcessRule: for each allowed candidate-workload phase-metric pair, compute noise across the three FRESH_REPETITION processes ordered by logical repetition 1,2,3
noise.roundingPoint: only after every unrounded Type-7 p95 and noise ratio is computed; comparison uses the unrounded ratio
noise.combineWithinAndCrossProcess: candidate experiment observedNoisePercent is the maximum of every applicable phase-metric within-process and cross-process cell; overall candidate is valid when PHASE_LOCAL or FRESH_REPETITION is valid

commonScalarTypes.nonnegativeInteger: JSON integer greater than or equal to zero; boolean forbidden
commonScalarTypes.positiveInteger: JSON integer greater than zero; boolean forbidden

allocationRawEnvelope.recordTypeRules: all ordinals, ticks, counters, requestedBytes and thread IDs are JSON integers; signedDeltaBytes is a signed JSON integer; retainedSinkIndex is null only for requestedBytes 0 and otherwise a unique nonnegative integer; retainedThroughAfterRead is boolean
allocationRawEnvelope.recordsShape: ordered JSON array; primary has exactly 90 WARMUP then 300 MEASURED records; diagnostics use their declared cardinality
allocationRawEnvelope.serializationOrder: all WARMUP triplets in ascending tripletOrdinal and controlOrdinal, then all MEASURED triplets in ascending tripletOrdinal and controlOrdinal
allocationRawEnvelope.headerRecordJoinRule: every record managed thread equals header managedThreadId; control/build/player/process/protocol/attempt identity joins the result inventory exactly

profilerAllocationRawEnvelope.derivedInvariants: signedDeltaBytes equals recorderValueAfter minus recorderValueBefore without clamp; ordinals/order/zero-positive allocation/retention/thread/timestamp rules equal the primary envelope; invalid or unavailable recorder state is preserved and cannot promote the primary
profilerAllocationRawEnvelope.recordsShape: ordered JSON array of exactly 90 WARMUP then 300 MEASURED records when available; empty only when availability outcome is UNAVAILABLE

headerTypes.diagnosticOutcome: null except NO_GC_REGION_DIAGNOSTIC, where it is SUPPORTED, UNSUPPORTED or FAILED

timingRawEnvelope.recordTypeRules: IDs/enums are strings; ordinals, processId, timestamps, thread IDs, wholeTickTicks and GC counters are JSON integers; cleanupProcessorTicks and runCleanupPhaseTicks follow phaseConditionalTypes
timingRawEnvelope.recordsShape: ordered JSON array with exact experiment cardinality
timingRawEnvelope.noGcDiagnosticCardinalityRule: NO_GC_REGION_DIAGNOSTIC with SUPPORTED has 2400 records and continues the declared run; UNSUPPORTED or FAILED has 0 records, remains diagnostic-only UNAVAILABLE, and cannot change primary/allocation/adoption-eligible timing validity
timingRawEnvelope.serializationOrder: declared workload order, then declared phase order, then that process experiment's logical repetition execution order, then ascending tickOrdinal 1..200
timingRawEnvelope.headerRecordJoinRule: every record experimentId, playerRunId and processId equals the header; buildId joins result process/build records; record count equals header recordCount

result.executionProgressPrefixRule: every completed array is an exact no-gap prefix of its protocol-declared execution order; processes join completedPlayerRunIds, raw inventory joins completedRawArtifactPaths, allocationSummaries join completedControlIds, timingSummaries join completedExperimentIds, and artifactInventory paths equal completedInventoryPaths in lexicographic UTF-8 order
result.buildCohortConditionalRule: exactly three required build records exist in declared order; mono-release-like MUST be AVAILABLE with non-null hashes and no reasons; diagnostic-only build records are AVAILABLE with non-null hashes or UNAVAILABLE with null Player/build hashes and exact reasons, and their unavailability cannot change primary/overall terminal
result.allocationSummaryConditionalRule: exactly four summaries in primary then three executed diagnostic control order for semantic terminals; outcome is RESPONSIVE, UNRESPONSIVE, UNAVAILABLE or INVALID; raw hash is null exactly when the joined diagnostic build is UNAVAILABLE, but a build-available recorder UNAVAILABLE outcome has a non-null empty-record profiler envelope hash; counts and medians are null for UNAVAILABLE and otherwise exact typed values; each non-null raw hash joins the sole processOrdinal 1 raw envelope
result.timingSummaryConditionalRule: exactly seven summaries in orderedExperiments order for semantic terminals; outcome is VALID, INVALID or UNAVAILABLE; diagnosticOutcome is null except NO_GC_REGION_DIAGNOSTIC and exactly matches its raw header; NO_GC UNSUPPORTED/FAILED maps to UNAVAILABLE with one non-null zero-record raw hash and null noise/count diagnostics; orderedRawArtifactSha256 count equals the experiment freshProcessCount; withinProcessMaximumNoisePercent is null only for FRESH_REPETITION or an experiment with fewer than three repetitions in one process; crossProcessMaximumNoisePercent is null only for experiments with fewer than three fresh processes; observedNoisePercent is null for diagnostic-only experiments and otherwise a fixed-six decimal string
result.replacementRecordsRule: ordered array of embedded objects with exactly replacementRecord fields; every object also exists at the declared standalone path with byte-identical canonical content and is hash-bound in artifactInventory; maximum length is 1

terminalDiscriminatedUnion.buildCohortsShape: zero-to-three prefix of required build order
terminalDiscriminatedUnion.summaryShape: only fully completed control/experiment prefix summaries
terminalDiscriminatedUnion.firstRawSampleObserved: false before retry-eligible failure; true otherwise

terminalDiscriminatedUnion.partialArraysRule: every array is the exact completed execution-order prefix declared by executionProgress; no fabricated placeholder

terminalDiscriminatedUnion.buildCohortsRule: all three records in order; diagnostic records may be UNAVAILABLE with conditional null hashes
terminalDiscriminatedUnion.processesRule: exactly 17 timing processes plus the primary allocation process plus one process for each diagnostic allocation control whose joined build is AVAILABLE; order is primary allocation, available diagnostic controls in declared order, then timing experiments/process ordinals

result.summaryAuthority: all summaries and terminalOutcome are canonical evaluator recomputations from hash-verified raw artifacts; producer summary booleans are forbidden

readbackReceipt.typeRules: resultSha256 and inventoryRootSha256 are sha256 values when FINAL and its complete inventory exist and null otherwise; readbackStatus is VALID or FAILED; reason is null for VALID and exact reason object for FAILED; runnerExitCode is 0 for VALID and 2 for FAILED

executionArtifactSchemas.hashRules: protocolSha256 hashes exact protocol bytes; raw/result/replacement/lock artifacts never contain their own hash; result artifactInventory stores exact size and SHA-256 of every other persisted raw/log/context/replacement artifact; evaluator hashes bytes before parse, immediately before FINAL emit and again after FINAL emit before lock release
executionArtifactSchemas.inventoryRootProcedure:
for artifactInventory in declared array order, append UTF-8 path=<path>
state=<state>
sizeBytes=<decimal>
sha256=<lowercase-hex>
 for each record and SHA-256 the concatenated bytes; paths are unique and array order is lexicographic by UTF-8 path bytes

preMeasurementInfrastructureRetry.maximumReplacementAttemptsScope: one total replacement for the entire protocol execution and one per original attempt

resultContract.terminalTruthTableNullSemantics: null means NOT_EVALUATED because a higher-precedence condition already selected the row; it is not a wildcard accepted after a lower-precedence value was evaluated
resultContract.candidateRule: primary allocation valid and PHASE_LOCAL or FRESH_REPETITION timing valid
resultContract.stdoutTemplate: Cleanup S3 E0 characterization: <terminal-enum> (diagnostic-only; awaiting E1)
resultContract.transportFailureStdoutLine: Cleanup S3 E0 characterization transport failure: result inadmissible (diagnostic-only; exit 2)
resultContract.stdoutRule: for an admissible VALID result/receipt pair, complete stdout contains exactly one line beginning with Cleanup S3 E0 characterization: and its enum exactly equals persisted terminalOutcome; on any transport/readback failure, stdout contains no semantic terminal line and exactly the transportFailureStdoutLine
